scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.test: npm run prisma:test:setup && npm run test:client && node ./node_modules/cross-env/src/bin/cross-env.js TEST_DATABASE_URL=file:../../../data/test.db npm --workspace @dafan/server run test
scripts.prisma:migrate: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-file.mjs && prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:test:setup: node ./node_modules/cross-env/src/bin/cross-env.js DATABASE_URL=file:../../../data/test.db node scripts/reset-test-database.mjs && node ./node_modules/cross-env/src/bin/cross-env.js DATABASE_URL=file:../../../data/test.db node scripts/ensure-sqlite-file.mjs && node ./node_modules/cross-env/src/bin/cross-env.js DATABASE_URL=file:../../../data/test.db prisma migrate deploy
scripts.seed:dev: node scripts/ensure-sqlite-file.mjs && prisma migrate deploy && node --import tsx/esm scripts/seed-dev.mjs
